observations.access_notes: User reports obtaining the article through a Safari free trial and supplying the PDF. This records user-provided access, not a trial or sign-in performed by the reviewer. PDF metadata naming Witold Bolt as print creator is not article authorship. Prior Chrome inspection established identity but read only the preview; that historical scope is unchanged.
observations.limitations: Printout is not a proof-validation artifact or an authenticated archival publisher version. Reading confirms what the essay says, not the correctness of its reported mathematical results or correspondence.
observations.refresh_scope: At November release and monthly thereafter, recheck publisher identity, date, corrections and accessible content; record access limits honestly. A stored printout does not attest that the live article is unchanged. Request a new authorized copy if substantive changes cannot be inspected.
